title: Applicationcollaboration aggregates Applicationcollaboration
description: The outer collaboration counts the inner collaboration as one of its participating members, such as a checkout subsystem that includes a payment collaboration, while the inner collaboration keeps its own identity and may also belong to other collaborations.
x-dr-evidence: A docker-compose file, Helm umbrella chart or architecture document lists one named group of cooperating services as a member of a larger named subsystem, for example a payment collaboration inside a checkout subsystem.
